terms.definitionEn: A state value that indicates a request is still in progress.
terms.definitionAr: حالة بتوضح إن طلب البيانات لسه شغال.

terms.definitionEn: A state value used to represent a failed request or processing step.
terms.definitionAr: حالة بتسجل إن الطلب أو معالجة البيانات فشلت.

terms.definitionEn: A browser API that starts an HTTP request and returns a Promise for its response.
terms.definitionAr: واجهة في المتصفح بتبدأ طلب HTTP وبتُرجع Promise للرد.

terms.definitionEn: An API that creates a signal which can cancel supported asynchronous operations such as fetch.
terms.definitionAr: واجهة بتعمل signal ممكن يلغي عمليات غير متزامنة مدعومة زي fetch.

terms.definitionEn: A signal passed to an asynchronous operation to communicate cancellation.
terms.definitionAr: إشارة بتتبعت للعملية غير المتزامنة علشان توصل طلب الإلغاء.

terms.definitionEn: A function returned by an Effect to stop or undo work before the Effect is replaced or removed.
terms.definitionAr: دالة Effect بترجعها علشان توقف أو تلغي شغل قبل استبدال الـ Effect أو إزالته.

terms.definitionEn: A result-ordering problem where asynchronous operations finish in an order different from the order they started.
terms.definitionAr: مشكلة ترتيب بتحصل لما العمليات غير المتزامنة تخلص بترتيب مختلف عن بدايتها.

terms.definitionEn: An object delivered by fetch that contains an HTTP status and methods for reading its body.
terms.definitionAr: الـ object اللي fetch بترجعه وبيحتوي على status وطرق قراءة المحتوى.

terms.definitionEn: A boolean Response property that is true when the HTTP status is in the successful range.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية boolean بتكون true لما HTTP status يدل على نجاح الطلب.

terms.definitionEn: Converting a JSON response body into a JavaScript value, usually with response.json().
terms.definitionAr: تحويل محتوى JSON لقيمة JavaScript، غالبًا باستخدام response.json().

terms.definitionEn: The sequence of starting a request and representing its pending, success, and failure outcomes.
terms.definitionAr: مراحل الطلب من بدايته لحد تمثيل الانتظار أو النجاح أو الفشل.

terms.definitionEn: A response from an earlier request that should no longer replace data for the current inputs.
terms.definitionAr: رد من طلب أقدم ماينفعش يستبدل بيانات المدخلات الحالية.

questions.question: What does the empty dependency array indicate?
options: The Effect runs after the initial mount, not after every ordinary re-render
The Effect runs during each render before React returns the component's JSX content
The Effect runs only after the fetch request finishes with a successful HTTP response
The Effect is removed from the component permanently and can never start any request
questions.explanation: With no reactive dependencies, this Effect is scheduled after mount and reruns when the component remounts.
questions.explanationAr: من غير dependencies متغيرة، الـ Effect بيتنفذ بعد الـ mount وبيتكرر لو component اتعملها mount تاني.

questions.question: What does loading represent in this pattern?
options: The response body parsed as JSON before any network request begins
Whether the request or its result handling is still pending
The HTTP status code converted into a boolean value for the component
Whether the browser is currently connected to the network and can send requests
questions.explanation: The state commonly tracks whether the request is still pending so the UI can show progress.
questions.explanationAr: الحالة دي غالبًا بتوضح إذا كان الطلب لسه مستني علشان الواجهة تعرض مؤشر تحميل.

questions.code:
const response = await fetch('/api/items');
const items = await response.json();
questions.question: What does response.json() do here?
options: It checks whether the server returned a 2xx status code
It converts the response headers into a JavaScript array
It reads and parses the response body as JSON
It retries the request if the body is not valid JSON
questions.explanation: The method reads the response body and parses JSON, returning a Promise for the parsed value.
questions.explanationAr: الميثود بتقرأ محتوى الرد وبتحلل JSON وبتُرجع Promise بالقيمة.

questions.code:
const response = await fetch('/api/items');
if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Request failed');
questions.question: Why check response.ok explicitly?
options: fetch rejects automatically for every HTTP 404 or 500 response without any status handling
response.ok contains the already parsed JSON data whenever the server request succeeds
The check converts an HTTP error status into an empty response body before parsing it
fetch can fulfill for HTTP error statuses, so this check turns them into errors
questions.explanation: fetch generally fulfills when an HTTP response arrives even if its status is an error status.
questions.explanationAr: fetch غالبًا بتنجح كـ Promise حتى لو HTTP status فيه خطأ، فالفحص بيحوّل الحالة لخطأ.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the ignore flag?
options: It prevents an earlier request from updating state after this Effect is cleaned up
It cancels the HTTP request immediately at the network layer before the server can process it
It makes loadUser run synchronously before every render so no Promise is created
It guarantees the server responds in the same order that the component started its requests
questions.explanation: Cleanup marks the request as obsolete so its eventual result is not applied to state.
questions.explanationAr: الـ cleanup بتعلّم الطلب إنه بقى قديم علشان نتيجته ما تتسجلش في الحالة.

questions.code:
const controller = new AbortController();
fetch(url, { signal: controller.signal });
questions.question: What role does controller.signal play?
options: It stores the response data after fetch finishes
It connects the request to a cancellation signal
It changes the HTTP request into a synchronous operation
It automatically retries if the request is aborted
questions.explanation: Passing the signal lets the fetch operation respond to an abort request from its controller.
questions.explanationAr: تمرير signal بيخلّي fetch تستجيب لطلب الإلغاء من الـ controller.

questions.question: Which outcomes does this catch handle?
options: Only errors caused by JSON syntax while parsing the body, never a rejected fetch
Only HTTP error statuses, because fetch always resolves without throwing for any reason
Rejected fetch operations and errors explicitly thrown in the try block
Only errors from calling a React state setter after a successfully parsed response
questions.explanation: The catch handles promise rejections and exceptions thrown while executing the try block.
questions.explanationAr: الـ catch بيمسك رفض الـ Promise وأي exception بتترمي جوه try.

questions.question: Why abort in the cleanup function?
options: To force the current request to return an HTTP 200 response from the server instead of its actual status
To prevent React from rendering the component again when any unrelated state setter is called
To parse any response body that has not finished loading and store its result before unmounting
To cancel supported work for the old URL when the Effect is replaced or removed
questions.explanation: Cleanup aborts the request tied to the previous Effect when url changes or the component is removed.
questions.explanationAr: الـ cleanup بتلغي طلب الـ Effect القديم لما url يتغير أو component تتشال.

questions.question: Why clear the previous error when starting another request?
options: So the next request can show its own result without keeping an outdated error visible while it is pending
So React treats the next response as a brand-new component instance with freshly initialized local component state
So fetch can serialize the error state and send it as a custom HTTP request header to the server
So a successful response will skip JSON parsing and use the old data value already stored
questions.explanation: Resetting the error state avoids displaying a stale failure while a new attempt is pending.
questions.explanationAr: مسح الخطأ القديم بيمنع عرض فشل سابق أثناء انتظار المحاولة الجديدة.

questions.code:
const response = { ok: false };
const message = response.ok ? 'success' : 'error';
questions.question: What is the value of message?
options: success
error
false
undefined
questions.explanation: The false ok value selects the ternary's second branch.
questions.explanationAr: قيمة ok هي false، فالتعبير بيرجع الفرع التاني.

questions.code:
const state = { loading: false, error: null, data: ['a', 'b'] };
const count = state.data.length;
questions.question: What is the value of count?
options: null
questions.explanation: The array contains two items, so its length is 2.
questions.explanationAr: الـ array فيها عنصرين، فـ length قيمتها 2.

questions.question: What is the value of shouldUpdate?
questions.explanation: After ignore becomes true, its negation is false.
questions.explanationAr: بعد ما ignore بقت true، عكسها بيكون false.

questions.prompt: Start an HTTP request and wait for its response.
questions.explanation: fetch starts the browser's HTTP request and returns a Promise.
questions.explanationAr: fetch بتبدأ طلب HTTP في المتصفح وبتُرجع Promise.

questions.prompt: Parse the response body as JSON.
questions.explanation: Response.json reads and parses the body as JSON.
questions.explanationAr: Response.json بتقرأ محتوى الرد وبتحلله كـ JSON.

questions.explanation: The ok property indicates whether the status is in the successful range.
questions.explanationAr: خاصية ok بتوضح إذا كان status ضمن نطاق النجاح.

questions.prompt: Pass the cancellation signal as a fetch option.
questions.explanation: The controller's signal connects fetch to the cancellation request.
questions.explanationAr: signal بتربط fetch بطلب الإلغاء.

questions.prompt: Cancel this controller's supported request in cleanup.
questions.explanation: Calling abort signals cancellation to operations using this controller's signal.
questions.explanationAr: استدعاء abort بيبعت إشارة إلغاء للعمليات اللي بتستخدم signal دي.

questions.prompt: Do not apply a result after the local ignore flag is set.
questions.explanation: The guard allows only results from an Effect that has not been cleaned up.
questions.explanationAr: الشرط بيسمح بتسجيل نتيجة الـ Effect اللي لسه ما اتعملهاش cleanup.

questions.prompt: Make this Effect run again when the resource identifier changes.
questions.explanation: Reactive values used by the Effect belong in its dependency list.
questions.explanationAr: القيم المتغيرة اللي الـ Effect بيستخدمها لازم تكون في dependency list.

questions.prompt: Clear the stored error before retrying the request.
questions.explanation: Calling the error setter with null clears the previous error value.
questions.explanationAr: استدعاء setter بقيمة null بيمسح الخطأ السابق.

questions.question: Why is it useful to represent loading, data, and error states separately?
keyPoints: The UI can distinguish pending, successful, and failed outcomes
A prior error should not remain visible during a retry
State transitions should be coordinated to avoid contradictory UI
questions.modelAnswer: Separate status and result values let the UI describe whether a request is pending, succeeded, or failed. Clear stale errors when retrying, and update the related state consistently so the interface does not show contradictory outcomes. For larger workflows, a reducer can make those transitions explicit.
questions.explanation: Explicit request states make asynchronous UI behavior easier to reason about.
questions.explanationAr: حالات الطلب الواضحة بتسهّل فهم سلوك الواجهة مع العمليات غير المتزامنة.

questions.question: What responsibilities belong in a data-fetching Effect, and what should it avoid?
keyPoints: Synchronize the component with an external request
Declare reactive dependencies used by the Effect
Do not make the Effect callback itself async
Handle pending, success, and failure deliberately
questions.modelAnswer: An Effect can start a request when its reactive inputs change and coordinate cleanup when that synchronization is no longer needed. Its callback should remain synchronous so it can return a cleanup function; put asynchronous work in an inner function instead. Include the reactive values the Effect reads in its dependency list.
questions.explanation: Effects synchronize with external systems and need predictable setup and cleanup.
questions.explanationAr: الـ Effect بتزامن component مع نظام خارجي وبتحتاج setup وcleanup واضحين.

questions.question: How can an application avoid showing a response for an outdated request?
keyPoints: Use an ignore flag or request identity in cleanup
Only apply results that still match current inputs
Cancellation and ignoring results solve related but distinct concerns
questions.modelAnswer: When request inputs change, cleanup can mark the previous operation obsolete or abort it with an AbortController. Before updating state, verify that the result still belongs to the current request. Aborting can save work, while ignoring a stale result protects state even when cancellation is unavailable or arrives too late.
questions.explanation: Guarding result application handles out-of-order completion safely.
questions.explanationAr: التحقق قبل تسجيل النتيجة بيحمي الحالة من الطلبات اللي خلصت بترتيب مختلف.

questions.question: When should an Effect use an AbortController for fetch?
keyPoints: Create a controller for the request
Pass its signal in fetch options
Abort from cleanup when the request is no longer relevant
Handle the rejection caused by cancellation appropriately
questions.modelAnswer: Create an AbortController for the request and pass its signal to fetch. Abort it in cleanup if the component no longer needs the request, such as when its URL changes or it unmounts. Handle abort rejection separately or otherwise ensure it is not shown as an unexpected user-facing failure.
questions.explanation: The controller ties a request's cancellation to the Effect lifecycle.
questions.explanationAr: الـ controller بيربط إلغاء الطلب بعمر الـ Effect.
